what: The 1px line under the ‹Learn more› text is empty by default, and on hover it is drawn from 0 starting at the left (.4s power2.in — slow at first, then snaps to the end), and on release it retracts from the current width to the left end (.4s power2.out — fast at first). Hovering again always draws anew from 0

options.dur: Line draw and retract duration (s), default .4

from.where: shared.css .ab-more (original .text-link-main-block’s .text-roll-line — IX3 mouseenter fromTo width 0→100% .4s power2.in · mouseleave to 0% .4s power2.out, width 0 at rest)
